audit_items.proof_trace: PKCE is fully enforced: code_challenge (S256 only) is required at the authorize endpoint and stored via the consent action; the token endpoint requires code_verifier and calls verifyCodeChallenge() which correctly computes sha256(verifier).base64url before issuing any token. Authorization codes are made single-use by deleting the code (line 83) immediately after fetching — the challenge data is already in memory, so the delete-before-validate ordering does not skip PKCE; it is an intentional anti-concurrent-replay measure.
